title: Capture and edit story notes in the dashboard

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict: Caught.** The maintained composer assertion detected incorrect text for revealed old line 40 on the intended Published completion path.

Story: `SEED-348#collect-notes-for-story-follow-ups`, “Capture and edit story notes in the dashboard”; source `.planning/seeds/SEED-348-collect-notes-for-story-follow-ups.md#collect-notes-for-story-follow-ups`; completed plan `.planning/slice-plans/671-capture-and-edit-story-notes-in-the-dashboard/PLAN.md`; selected revision `bddedd3dbaec4593424e2cbcdfe22e78d1dc1291`.

The selected promise is that a line note keeps the displayed line's original text, number and side in its composer and saved context. I validated the supplied target against the story and revision and reused the existing maintained test without changing its fixtures or assertions. Its fixture makes `expand-context.txt` contain 160 numbered lines, changes line 54, publishes the completion, and reveals preceding context before selecting old line 40.

One temporary fault changed `dashboard/src/StoryReviewDiffLines.tsx:173`, at the ContextGap line-menu binding: revealed context's Add note callback forwarded `"Incorrect revealed context"` instead of the supplied original line text, preserving the line number and side. Printed hunk callbacks kept their original binding. The patch is retained in `fault.diff` with the external evidence below.

All three runs used the same focused command, sequentially with one worker:

```sh
caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --reporter=list --workers=1 review/story-review-diff-add-note.spec.ts --grep 'Published diff file and line notes'
```

Baseline: one test passed. Faulted: that test failed at `dashboard/tests/support/storyNotesPage.ts:116`, called by `e2e/review/story-review-diff-add-note.spec.ts:108`, expecting the composer form to contain `line 40`. It instead contained `Line 40 · old` and `Incorrect revealed context`. The earlier menu and context assertions had passed. Restored: the same test passed, including its later saved-note checks at lines 129 and 135 for `Line 40 · old` and `line 40`.

Independent wrong-behavior witness: I inspected the retained browser trace's action sequence and DOM snapshots, then visually inspected its final screenshot. Trace calls `xtwi@185`, `xtwi@187`, and `xtwi@191` show “Show 20 preceding”, “Old line 40”, and that menu's Add note selection. The post-expansion DOM shows unchanged line 40 under the omitted-context list with displayed code `line 40`. The post-Add note DOM and screenshot show the composer for `Line 40 · old` displaying `Incorrect revealed context`; the original `line 40` remains visible in the diff behind it. This establishes wrong visible behavior on the exercised path and confirms the fresh faulted build reached the page. The failure occurred before saving the faulty old-40 note, so the catching assertion is the composer-text assertion. The claim is limited to that revealed old-line path in Published completion's Review changes.

Restoration and cleanup: I used a detached scratch worktree at the selected revision and verified Node 24.21.0 matched `.node-version` and the parent dependency lock hash before linking its existing node_modules. The pre-probe state had a clean tracked tree/index and only that owned untracked dependency link. An EXIT/signal trap restored the source from a byte copy. The restored source, porcelain state and index matched their pre-probe records; the renewed focused test passed. I removed the owned dependency link, verified empty porcelain plus clean tracked/index diffs, and removed the owned worktree without force, confirming its path and Git registration were gone. The parent checkout, fixtures, assertions, publication, backlog and observers were untouched. Each run built into its own temporary app output from scratch sources. AC power, 16 CPUs and the absence of another active local heavy proof were checked before launch; caffeinate protected all three runs.

Evidence retained for the caller: `/tmp/dough348-intent-coverage-evidence-1794889125914/` contains baseline/faulted/restored logs, the fault diff, original source, restoration/state records, cleanup record, browser trace, `witness-excerpt.json`, and the inspected `faulted-visible-composer.jpeg`. The full faulted trace and error-context snapshot are under its `faulted-test-results/2026-11-17T04-20-34.124Z-77875/review-story-review-diff-a-29de3-eep-their-immutable-context-chromium/` directory.

**Next proof action:** Keep the maintained composer assertion and its saved-context checks, and return this bounded evidence to Story Wrap Up for its protection-risk disposition. No test repair is indicated by this probe. No prior repair or disposition was supplied for this promise; this result creates no new repair decision.
